label: SlateportCity_Text_IncenseScholar
before: Incense still matters for breeding, but not as a scarce battle tool. / Check CENTER vendors and local shops.$
after:
You don't need Incense to get baby POKéMON from compatible parents.

Some Incenses have effects in battle, though. The CENTER vendors can help you find them.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
before: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please? / I don't grind. Nobody has to. I built a team, and a GYM is where you test one.$
after:
WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?

I feel so much better since moving to VERDANTURF. RALTS and I have been practicing every day!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
before: WALLY: I'm not pushing it. / RALTS and I found five partners who cover each other. We can beat anyone!$
after: WALLY: We've made new friends, too! I want to see how far we can go together.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
before: WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}! / I've built a real doubles team since we met. I want you and my UNCLE to see it. / Please, will you battle me?$
after:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!

Do you remember helping me catch RALTS? We've come a long way since then.

Please, will you battle me? I want to show my UNCLE I'm ready.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
before: WALLY: Oh… If you won't, my UNCLE will never believe my team is real.$
after: WALLY: Oh… All right. I was hoping you could help me show him.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
before: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you. / WEAVILE leads, ZAPDOS sets the wind… Okay. Here I come!$
after:
WALLY: Thank you, {PLAYER}!

All right, everyone. Let's show them what we can do!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyDefeat
before: WALLY: ... / I had a plan for every partner. You still found your way through. / I lost...$
after:
WALLY: I… I lost.

I really thought we were ready…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
before: WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to VERDANTURF. / I know what my team was missing now.$
after:
WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to VERDANTURF.

But I don't want to give up. RALTS and I still have so much to learn.

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
before: There are POKéMON that evolve when you trade them! That's what I heard.$
after:
Some POKéMON evolve when you trade them.

A LINKING CORD lets you evolve those partners yourself, too. Ask a CENTER vendor about evolution items!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
before: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Shopping? The CENTER gives out held items free, but choosing is the fun part. / I've rebuilt my team around the POKéMON I found on the way. Let's see how yours has grown!$
after:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Are you shopping, too?

I was looking for a gift for Dad, but I keep finding things I want!

It's been ages since our last battle. Want to show me your team?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
before: MAY: Not now? Come on. Nobody needs to grind here. Bring the plan you have.$
after: MAY: Another time, then! I'll be here trying to choose a present.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe
before: MAY: Come on, battle me so I can see how you build now!$
after: MAY: Ready for a battle? I've met some wonderful POKéMON since ROUTE 119!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten
before: MAY: My six have an answer for everything. Let's see yours answer them!$
after: MAY: All right! Everyone, let's give it our best!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
before: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}. Running an errand for Dad. No, not DOLLS. / It's been a while. Let's see whose six got smarter since ROUTE 119.$
after:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! Running an errand for Dad. No, I'm not buying DOLLS!

It's been a while since ROUTE 119. Got time for a battle?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
before: BRENDAN: What, no plan ready? That's new for you.$
after: BRENDAN: Got other plans? Fair enough. Come find me when you're ready!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe
before: BRENDAN: Battle me. I want to see how you build now.$
after: BRENDAN: How about that battle? I've been looking forward to it!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
before: {PLAYER}, what's next? The rest of the BADGES and the LEAGUE? / Maybe I'll do that too… / Anyway. Keep reading them faster.$
after:
BRENDAN: What's next, {PLAYER}? The rest of the BADGES, then the LEAGUE?

Maybe I'll try that, too. But first, Dad's waiting for these supplies.

Don't get too far ahead of me!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
before: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? I'm doing great! / I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is pretty strong, so I decided to come take a look-see for myself. / But there's something wrong about this town. / People are going on about a warning letter and the SPACE CENTER… / I don't think it concerns me in any way, though.$
after:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}! I came to watch the GYM, but everyone's worried about a threat to the SPACE CENTER.

STEVEN is looking into it. I hope those researchers are safe.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
before: MAXIE: GROUDON, stop! I wanted land that could sustain a future, not consume it. / My certainty left no room for yours.$
after:
MAXIE: GROUDON, stop!

I wanted more land for people and POKéMON to live on. You're burning the homes they already have!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
before: MAXIE: RAYQUAZA did not overpower both rivals. It restored their relationship. / All our models optimized one side of a system that could only live in balance.$
after:
MAXIE: The heat is fading… RAYQUAZA stopped them.

I was so certain more land would help HOENN. I wouldn't listen to anyone who questioned me.

Look what that certainty nearly cost us.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
before: ARCHIE: Land, sea, and sky returned to motion without belonging to any of us. / AQUA tried to free the world by choosing its answer for it. That was control too.$
after:
ARCHIE: The rain's stopped. People can come out again.

I said I was protecting sea POKéMON. I nearly washed away every home along this coast.

We have to return the ORBS, MAXIE.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
before: STEVEN: Power without relationship looks terrifying. You already know the answer: a partner is not a tool to command.$
after:
STEVEN: I understand why people are frightened. Neither leader could control the POKéMON they awakened.

But POKéMON have helped us through this, too. We must find a way to stop the fighting.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
before: STEVEN: RAYQUAZA did not make them flee. It reminded land and sea of the whole.$
after:
STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…

Just as the old tale said, it stopped their clash. You reached it in time, {PLAYER}.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
before: WALLACE: MAXIE and ARCHIE caused this, but both finally understand the cost. / Hear them. Accountability matters more when the motive once sounded noble.$
after:
WALLACE: MAXIE and ARCHIE are still here. They owe you an explanation.

Returning the ORBS will be a start. There is much more for them to put right.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
before: WALLACE: You did not win by possessing the strongest POKéMON in the crater. / You found the one relationship that made every other action possible. / HOENN is safe. Please accept this.$
after:
WALLACE: You crossed HOENN to stop this disaster, then climbed SKY PILLAR when we needed you most.

Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. SOOTOPOLIS is safe again. Please accept this.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
before: WALLACE: JUAN's Gym is the final test before the LEAGUE. Expect no mercy.$
after:
WALLACE: JUAN, my mentor, leads this city's GYM. His BADGE is the last you need for the LEAGUE.

You've helped our city through so much. I look forward to seeing how far your journey takes you.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
before: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH? / Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice! / You're your father's child, all right. You look good together with POKéMON! / Here, honey! If you're going out on an adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES. / They'll put a zip in your step!$
after:
MOM: {PLAYER}! Did you meet PROF. BIRCH?

Oh! Look at your two new friends! You're setting off together? How lovely!

Your father will be so proud. Here, honey, take these RUNNING SHOES.

They'll put a zip in your step!

label: OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation
before: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's even more useful than a POKéMON CENTER in certain situations.$
after:
A POTION can help an injured partner while you're exploring.

You can't use your BAG during TRAINER battles, so patch everyone up before a challenge!

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
before: The meadow west of town reopened after the cave began shining. / An abandoned manor there holds DEVON's oldest records of MEGA EVOLUTION.$
after:
There's a meadow west of town. Lately, travelers have spotted some very unusual POKéMON there.

The old manor holds records of MEGA EVOLUTION. Someone must have studied it here long ago.

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
before: MAY: I took the partner you left with Dad. PIKACHU and the rest of my team are ready too! / Bring the team you want. Ready for our DOUBLE BATTLE?$
after:
MAY: The partner you left with Dad has joined my team!

I've been so excited to introduce everyone. Ready for our DOUBLE BATTLE?

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
before: BRENDAN: I took the partner you left with Dad. PIKACHU and the rest of my team are ready too! / Bring the team you want. Ready for our DOUBLE BATTLE?$
after:
BRENDAN: I took the partner you left with Dad. We're getting along great!

Let's see how your team and mine measure up. DOUBLE BATTLE. Ready?

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
before: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! I've been catching partners on every route since OLDALE. / Two of them cover each other in a way I want to test. Doubles, right now!$
after:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! I've been finding new POKéMON all the way from OLDALE.

You must have met some, too! Let's have a battle and introduce them!

label: Route110_Text_MayDefeated
before: You broke my pair before it clicked!$
after: Wow! You've gotten stronger!

label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
before: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}. Figured you'd come this way. / I built a pair that covers each other. Let's see if your six can read it.$
after:
BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}! Figured you'd come this way.

I've been looking forward to another battle. Let's see how far we've come!

label: Route110_Text_BrendanDefeated
before: Hmm… You read the pair fast.$
after: Hah… You've been busy, too!

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
before: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! The storms up here rewrote my whole team. / I want to know if you still adapt faster than I do. Ready? Go!$
after:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! There you are!

I keep stopping to take notes, and then the rain washes them away!

A battle will cheer us up. Ready?

label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
before: You changed plans mid-storm!$
after: Whew! That was worth getting soaked for!

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
before: MAY: Your FLIGHT BEACON turns on once you hold the FEATHER BADGE. / WINONA awards it at FORTREE GYM. Just follow this road north! / Use it from the BAG. Any town you've seen, instantly. / Go home sometime. Mom asks about you. / Maybe we'll meet at the LEAGUE!$
after:
MAY: Your FLIGHT BEACON works once you earn the FEATHER BADGE from WINONA in FORTREE.

Follow this road north! Then use the beacon from your BAG to fly to towns you've visited.

Stop by home sometime. Your mom would love to see you!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
before: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! The rain up here made me rebuild everything. / Let's see whose rebuild is better. It's a battle, so battle!$
after:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! I wondered when you'd catch up.

A little rain hasn't stopped us practicing. Come on, let's battle!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
before: BRENDAN: You could build a team for any route in HOENN now. / Here. Try this out.$
after: BRENDAN: I knew you'd give us a good battle. Here, take this!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
before: {RIVAL} is out studying on ROUTE 103. You should go introduce your partner! / {RIVAL}'s POKéMON has the type edge. Visit OLDALE's POKéMON CENTER first. / The LEVELER trains your POKéMON to the current level limit, free of charge. / Would you like to go find {RIVAL}?$
after:
{RIVAL} is studying POKéMON on ROUTE 103. Why not introduce your new partners?

OLDALE's CENTER can help you prepare. Its free LEVELER brings your POKéMON up to the current training limit.

Would you like to go find {RIVAL}?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
before: PROF. BIRCH: Now… / {PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two of you help me study POKéMON. / Your POKéDEX recorded every region from the day your journey began. / Now I can synchronize our final field notes and mark FRONTIER research. / Here, let me see your POKéDEX units.$
after:
PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}, {RIVAL}, you've both brought back so many field notes!

Your POKéDEX units could record every region from the start. Let's add our latest observations to both.

May I see them for a moment?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexResearchReward
before: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Let's have a look at your POKéDEX. / … … … … … … … … … … … … / Every known HOENN species. Wonderful! You proved how each habitat connects. / DEVON helped me restore five tools from our LEGENDARY FORM research. / They let certain rare POKéMON change or combine outside battle. Take them!$
after:
PROF. BIRCH: Every known HOENN species! What a remarkable record of your journey.

I've kept a spare set of our legendary form tools here. Take any you're missing!

They're also in the CENTER vendors' Evolution Items archive. Your MEGA RING gives you access there.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardComplete
before: Those tools affect KYUREM, ZYGARDE, NECROZMA, and CALYREX. / The POKéMON must still choose you. The tools only reveal forms they can take.$
after:
The tools let KYUREM, ZYGARDE, NECROZMA, and CALYREX change forms or combine with certain partners.

There's always something new to learn about POKéMON!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
before: DAD: Four BADGES brought you back, but this battle is not about raw growth. / Every member of my team reveals a rule: a lock, an Ability, an item, or a clock. / Read each one before you commit. I will battle as GYM LEADER, not as your father.$
after:
DAD: Four BADGES already… I still remember you setting out from LITTLEROOT.

I'm proud of you, {PLAYER}. But here in the GYM, I have to give every challenger my best.

Show me how far you and your POKéMON have come!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
before: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL / “A scale replica of the ship under construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”$
after:
“THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL”

“A scale replica of the vessel designed at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
before: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship? / I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…$
after: The ferry opens to TRAINERS with six BADGES. Come back with the FEATHER BADGE!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
before: Your ferry pass is not registered. / I'm terribly sorry. / You need a registered pass to board the ferry.$
after: You'll need a ferry pass. With six BADGES, speak to the sailor at LILYCOVE HARBOR. He can register yours.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
before: Send current -- LANTURN drinks it. Send water -- HELIOLISK drinks that. / What is left in your bag?$
after:
Send electricity, and LANTURN drinks it. Send water, and HELIOLISK drinks that.

What else can your partners do?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
before: One of our research staff stupidly got robbed of an important parcel.$
after: One of our researchers was robbed of an important parcel. I hope he's all right.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
before: That stolen parcel… / Well, sure it's important, but it's not anything that anyone can use. / In my estimation, that robber must not have been very bright.$
after:
That parcel holds instruments for CAPT. STERN's research.

Who would go to so much trouble to steal them? They must know what the captain is studying.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
before: It's beyond stupid. How could we get robbed?$
after: After that robbery, we're being much more careful with our research deliveries.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
before: The man next door gave me an HM! / I used it to teach my POKéMON how to CUT down skinny trees.$
after:
The man next door gave me CUT!

With the STONE BADGE and a compatible partner, I can clear skinny trees. It doesn't take up a battle move slot.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
before: I am WINONA, FORTREE's GYM LEADER. / The sky controls position: wind decides speed, wings evade Ground, snow hides the final horizon. / Preserve the answer you will need after the weather changes.$
after:
I am WINONA, FORTREE's GYM LEADER.

My POKéMON and I have flown through clear skies and sudden storms. We know how quickly the wind can turn.

Show me how your team meets a changing sky!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
before: You denied the wind without losing sight of the snow. Accept the FEATHER BADGE.$
after: You've carried your team through our strongest winds. The FEATHER BADGE is yours.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
before: A flying team is not one species label. It is freedom of position. Remember that. / To follow AQUA to MT. PYRE, head east through ROUTES 120 and 121, then SURF south on ROUTE 122. / Find what drew them to that quiet place.$
after:
WINONA: A strong wind can carry you far, but you must choose where to go.

To follow AQUA to MT. PYRE, head east through ROUTES 120 and 121, then SURF south on ROUTE 122.

I hope the people there are safe.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaAfterPyre
before: A flying team is not one species label. It is freedom of position. Remember that.$
after:
WINONA: A strong wind can carry you far, but you must choose where to go.

May your journey bring you clear skies.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
before: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship? / I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…$
after: The ferry opens to TRAINERS with six BADGES. Come back with the FEATHER BADGE!

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
before: Your ferry pass is not registered. / I'm terribly sorry. / You need a registered pass to board the ferry.$
after: You'll need a ferry pass. With six BADGES, speak to the sailor here in LILYCOVE HARBOR. He can register yours.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_LatiReport
before: Two flying POKéMON were spotted! / One now travels HOENN's routes. The other rests on SOUTHERN ISLAND. / Which color did you hear about on the mainland: red or blue?$
after:
I've received two sightings: red LATIAS and blue LATIOS!

One will travel HOENN's routes. The other waits on SOUTHERN ISLAND.

Which mainland lead shall we follow: red or blue?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
before: METAGROSS resists half of what you own, and MIMIKYU gets a free turn. / Break the disguise early!$
after:
METAGROSS is tough to break through, and MIMIKYU hides behind its DISGUISE.

Can you get past both of them?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
before: LATIOS moves before you do, and AEGISLASH punishes your reply. / Choose your swing carefully!$
after:
LATIOS is quick, and AEGISLASH can make a careless attack costly.

Choose your moment!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
before: TATE: We share one board. LIZA: But we can give it two move orders. / TATE: Psychic Terrain denies priority. LIZA: TRICK ROOM punishes speed. / TATE: Break our timing... LIZA: ...before GARDEVOIR takes over.$
after:
TATE: We grew up battling together.
LIZA: We know when to help each other.

TATE: Psychic Terrain protects grounded partners from priority moves.

LIZA: And under TRICK ROOM…
TATE: …the slowest may move first!

BOTH: Ready to face us?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
before: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but… / The rocket's launch is imminent!$
after:
We were preparing for a launch when MAGMA arrived.

The crew needs that fuel. We can't let them take it!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
before: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but… / The rocket launched safely! That's launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$
after:
We'd completed launch no. {STR_VAR_1} safely. Then TEAM MAGMA arrived.

I can't believe they're trying to steal our fuel!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
before: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights set on our SPACE CENTER. / But we can't allow anything that minor to interfere with our rocket launch!$
after:
Those MAGMA thugs have threatened the SPACE CENTER.

We're securing the rocket fuel. If they take it, they could do terrible damage.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
before: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal the rocket fuel. / Oh, by the way, you can have this stone I found on the beach.$
after:
TEAM MAGMA mustn't get that fuel!

I found this SUN STONE on the beach. If it can help one of your POKéMON, please take it.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
before: Three consecutive formations guard this corridor. You still choose to advance?$
after:
You'll have to battle all three of us, one after another!

Still want to come through?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAnswer
before: A sound decision. Recover your team before challenging the full sequence.$
after: That's right. Go downstairs while you can!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
before: First formation: establish pressure before you can read the sequence.$
after: I'm first! You're not getting past this corridor!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
before: First line broken. The sequence holds.$
after: What?! It's your turn. Stop that kid!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
before: Second formation: punish the answer you revealed in the first.$
after: You beat one of us. Let's see you beat two!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
before: You changed plans between battles…$
after: Oh, no… It's all up to you now!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Intro
before: Final formation: exploit the damage the first two left behind. No reset.$
after: I'm the last one! MAXIE's counting on me!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
before: Your team endured the whole sequence…$
after: All three of us… defeated!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
before: Three battles should expose every answer. You kept finding new ones.$
after: Three of us guarding one corridor. I thought this would be an easy job.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
before: Attrition favored us. Adaptation favored you.$
after: I can't believe you beat us all. What do I tell MAXIE?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
before: MAXIE's model did not account for a team that improves while being worn down.$
after: We were supposed to keep everyone downstairs until MAXIE had the fuel.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
before: You broke the corridor and reached the launch floor. That ends here. / Our final formation protects MAXIE and the fuel at the same time.$
after:
The others couldn't stop you? Then we will!

MAXIE isn't leaving without that fuel.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDontInterfere
before: MAXIE: The calculation has reached its final input. Do not interfere.$
after: MAXIE: You again? STEVEN is already wasting my time. Stand aside!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenAreYouReadyToBattle
before: STEVEN: {PLAYER}! We fight together. Their formation is built for two targets. / Are you ready to break it as partners?$
after:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}! Help me stop them.

Are you ready to battle alongside me?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_TabithaDefeat
before: The launch angle collapsed…$
after: I couldn't keep you away…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_TabithaIntro
before: TABITHA: The rocket needs a stable base. / My sand formation will pin both of your POKéMON before you reach MAXIE.$
after: TABITHA: MAXIE needs that rocket fuel. My orders are to keep everyone else away!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_TabithaAfter
before: You broke the foundation, but the real launch sequence is still ahead.$
after: TABITHA: You beat me, but MAXIE won't leave empty-handed. STEVEN is still trying to stop him.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_CourtneyDefeat
before: Joint model... broken by partnership.$
after: COURTNEY: Defeated… Both of us.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_CourtneyFormation
before: COURTNEY: MAXIE supplies force. I supply the alternate clock. STEVEN is accounted for. You remain the unstable variable.$
after:
COURTNEY: STEVEN… and you.

MAXIE, I'll cover you. We still need that fuel.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
before: MAXIE: Again, your partnership adapted while my certainty narrowed. / We failed to control GROUDON, and now we would destroy what refused control. / If MAGMA's premise is wrong, then AQUA's opposite certainty must be wrong as well.$
after:
MAXIE: We couldn't control GROUDON. So I came here to take fuel and force an eruption anyway.

I nearly destroyed the very land I claimed to protect.

If I was this wrong… ARCHIE may be making the same mistake at sea.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
before: MAXIE: Keep the fuel. I must find GROUDON before ARCHIE repeats the same mistake.$
after:
MAXIE: Keep the fuel. We're leaving.

I must find GROUDON, and stop ARCHIE before he awakens KYOGRE.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
before: STEVEN: That was true doubles play: each of us made the other's options better. / Come to my home west of the GYM. I have the HM DIVE for you. / We can use it to follow AQUA's stolen submarine.$
after:
STEVEN: Thank you, {PLAYER}. Together, we kept the staff and their research safe.

Come to my home west of the GYM. I have DIVE for you.

You'll need it to follow AQUA's stolen submarine.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
before: I am JUAN, WALLACE's mentor, keeper of SOOTOPOLIS's final examination. / You calmed one impossible rain. Now face rain used deliberately: speed, endurance and growing power. / Artistry gives each choice purpose. Show me yours.$
after:
I am JUAN, WALLACE's mentor and SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER.

You have done our city a great service. Now let us meet as TRAINERS.

My partners thrive in rain. Each brings a different strength to our performance. Shall we begin?

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
before: Everyone in town has taken refuge and won't come out of their homes. / Even I would rather not venture outside.$
after:
Many families are sheltering indoors until the weather settles.

I'd rather stay here, too. That clash outside is frightening.

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
before: MT. PYRE… / At its peak are two orbs placed side by side. Did you know?$
after:
MT. PYRE… I once visited its summit and saw the two ORBS in the elders' care.

Have you heard their story?

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
before: Yes, two orbs side by side… / The sight of them together… It is somehow soothing…$
after:
The elders said those ORBS were passed down for generations.

I still remember how carefully they watched over them.

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
before: Is that so? Perhaps you ought to visit and see…$
after: The elders at MT. PYRE can tell you. They've kept HOENN's old stories alive for so long.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
before: You honored what you could not touch. My grandmother would like you.$
after: What a wonderful team! My grandmother would love to meet your POKéMON.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
before: DRAKE is old, and his Dragons are not all alike. Study each one.$
after:
DRAKE waits ahead. He's sailed through many storms with his DRAGON POKéMON.

You have earned his full attention.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
before: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}. / Across HOENN, moves, items and rare partners offered new possibilities. Mega Evolution opened even more. / You restored SOOTOPOLIS's balance and beat the ELITE FOUR under the LEAGUE's battle rules. / Now face the region's complete exam. My team is ready. Is yours? / Show me the Champion you became!$
after:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}.

When we met in SOOTOPOLIS, HOENN needed your courage. Today, you've come here to pursue your own dream.

Eight BADGES. The ELITE FOUR. You and your partners have earned this challenge.

I am WALLACE, HOENN's CHAMPION. I will give you everything I have!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
before: WALLACE: This victory belongs to you and the partners who brought you here. / Every choice along the way helped shape the TRAINER before me. / You stand at HOENN's peak, but the FRONTIER waits beyond the summit. / I proclaim you the new HOENN CHAMPION!$
after:
WALLACE: This victory belongs to you and the partners who brought you here.

All the roads you traveled, all the people and POKéMON you met… They brought you to this moment.

I proclaim you the new HOENN CHAMPION!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
before: BIRCH: You did it, {PLAYER}! / You began with one of nine traditions, then made HOENN's whole ecosystem yours. / Let me see the POKéDEX that recorded all those possible teams.$
after:
BIRCH: You did it, {PLAYER}!

It seems like yesterday you and those two POKéMON rescued me on ROUTE 101. Now look at you!

May I see your POKéDEX? I'd love to see the record of your journey.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
before: BIRCH: Congratulations. The final room records one team; HOENN remembers all.$
after:
BIRCH: Congratulations, {PLAYER}! Your parents will be so proud.

And thank you, all of you POKéMON, for looking after our new CHAMPION!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
before: MAY: Groan… / … … … … … … … … / Kidding! That's the rule, and you earned every part of it. / {PLAYER}{KUN}! Honestly, congratulations!$
after:
MAY: Aww… I wanted to come, too!

Hehe! Go on, {PLAYER}{KUN}. This is your moment.

I'm so happy for you. Congratulations!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
before: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … … / Fine. That's the rule, and I watched you earn it. / {PLAYER}, way to go! Congratulations!$
after:
BRENDAN: What?! I wanted to see it!

All right, all right. You earned this, {PLAYER}.

Way to go! Dad will be talking about this for weeks!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
before: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE! / I'm happy for you! You made my cheering worthwhile! / {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION… / I'll get in touch with you then. / Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Go for greatness!$
after:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}! You've made it to the POKéMON LEAGUE!

I knew you were one to watch. Now you've got a shot at the championship!

I'll be cheering for you. Give them a battle they'll remember!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
before: COURTNEY: You crossed our operation twice. Coincidence is no longer likely. / This formation will remove you from MAXIE's equation.$
after:
COURTNEY: The METEORITE is ours.

You won't take it from us. I'll stop you here.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_CourtneyDefeat
before: You broke our celestial formation…$
after: COURTNEY: You broke through…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_GruntDefeat
before: Even the meteor team failed?!$
after: We lost, even here?!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
before: ARCHIE: We met at SLATEPORT's MUSEUM. {PLAYER}, wasn't it? / I mistook you for one of MAGMA's crew. You proved you choose your own current. / MAXIE thinks every living system can be measured, fixed, and made obedient. / Now he means to force that certainty through MT. CHIMNEY. / AQUA will stop him. If you value a world that can still change, follow us.$
after:
ARCHIE: We met at SLATEPORT's MUSEUM. {PLAYER}, wasn't it?

You stopped my crew there. But we both know what MAGMA is planning now.

If MAXIE sets off MT. CHIMNEY, the lava could destroy habitats all the way to the coast.

We're going after him. You can help, if you mean to stop that eruption.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
before: ARCHIE: We move now. / If MAGMA drives that METEORITE into the fault line, the mountain answers first.$
after: ARCHIE: Right! No time to waste. Get to MT. CHIMNEY before MAXIE starts that machine!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
before: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, come to MT. CHIMNEY. Take the cable car on ROUTE 112. / You have already changed this race.$
after: ARCHIE: ROUTE 112's cable car leads to the summit. We'll see you there, {PLAYER}!

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_NoStarterStone
before: Your original partners have no applicable Mega Stone here. / Your other teammates can carry one!$
after:
I don't have a matching Mega Stone for your original partners here.

Keep exploring. Other members of your team may be able to Mega Evolve, too!

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ArchiveOpen
before: The RING lets your partners use the Mega Stones you find across HOENN. / Look for their glimmer off the path. People may have stones to share, too. / POKéMON CENTER VENDORS still offer evolution items free of charge.$
after:
The RING lets your partners use Mega Stones you find across HOENN. Look off the path, and talk to people you meet!

It also opens the CENTER vendors' free Evolution Items archive. Legendary form tools are there, too.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TartAppleExplanation
before: It's a TART APPLE. Use it to evolve the right APPLIN. / Evolution items reward exploring even when battle gear is easy to obtain.$
after:
It's a TART APPLE. Use it on APPLIN to evolve it into FLAPPLE.

Funny how the same POKéMON can grow differently depending on its favorite treat!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
before: You found the flaw before I could stabilize the field...$
after: You stopped my team… How?!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
before: MAXIE: The METEORITE was one input, not the plan itself. The BLUE ORB remains. / You stopped this eruption, but the fault line is already moving beneath HOENN.$
after:
MAXIE: You've stopped this machine. But MAGMA's work will continue.

There is a greater power beneath HOENN. We will find a way to awaken it.

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
before: TABITHA: You followed the METEORITE. Good. You understand the real objective. / MAXIE already has it. My formation only needs to keep you from his machine.$
after:
TABITHA: So you followed us from METEOR FALLS!

MAXIE is working with the METEORITE. I'm not letting you near his machine!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
before: You broke the guard line too quickly…$
after: I couldn't hold you off!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
before: MAXIE, begin the fault-line sequence! The delay model has failed.$
after: TABITHA: MAXIE! The intruder is coming!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
before: My certainty cracked first…$
after: I couldn't protect the machine…

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
before: This ridge could become solid ground, not a threat hanging over LAVARIDGE. / I believe in that future enough to defend it.$
after:
LAVARIDGE sits beside a volcano. Imagine if we could make all that land safe!

That's what MAXIE promised us. I'm not letting you stop him!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
before: Belief was not enough to hold the line…$
after: Even with all our training…

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
before: You came through fire to challenge us. Maybe certainty is not the same as truth.$
after: I thought this would make people feel safer. Why are they all so frightened?

label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
before: AQUA keeps changing the field before our formation can stabilize it.$
after: Those AQUA grunts keep trying to reach our machine!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
before: Stand back! We are forcing the mountain into a stable state for everyone.$
after: Stand back! MAXIE is working at the crater!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
before: MAGMA builds fixed ground. AQUA trusts change without limits. / Do not confuse opposite answers.$
after:
MAGMA wants more land. AQUA wants more sea.

And neither side is giving way today!

label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
before: We will make the fault line hold!$
after: More land means more places to live! That's why we're here!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
before: ARCHIE: You stopped him. I owe you that. / But do not confuse AQUA with MAGMA. We would free the old current, not cage it. / Take JAGGED PASS down to LAVARIDGE. Your next GYM is there. / That METEORITE is still in the machine. COZMO in FALLARBOR may want it back. / If you stand in our way again, I will expect an even better battle.$
after:
ARCHIE: You stopped him. I owe you that.

The sea POKéMON along this coast can breathe easy. But AQUA's work isn't finished.

JAGGED PASS leads down to LAVARIDGE. You've earned a rest.

And that METEORITE is still in the machine. COZMO in FALLARBOR will want it back.

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
before: MAGMA fixed every approach at once. We cannot break their formation!$
after: MAGMA outnumbers us! We can't get through to the machine!

label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
before: If they seal the currents, every WATER POKéMON below loses its habitat!$
after: If lava pours into the sea, what happens to the POKéMON living there?

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
before: AQUA keeps life moving. MAGMA would freeze the world into one answer.$
after: We joined AQUA to protect the sea. We can't let MAGMA destroy it!

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
before: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine… / The machine seems to be storing energy in the METEORITE.$
after: A METEORITE is fitted into the machine. Cables run from it toward the crater.

label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
before: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH LAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD$
after:
{DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PASS
LAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattIntro
before: MATT: Rain does more than boost Water. It heals, redirects Fire, and changes tempo. / Break AQUA's formation before the wind!$
after:
MATT: Hey, I know you! ARCHIE said you'd turn up again.

He needs more time at the summit. So you get to battle me!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattDefeat
before: You kept one answer outside the current.$
after: You're tougher than I expected!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
before: MAGMA reached the ORBS first, but their fixed formation left a path behind them. / AQUA will take that path and the ORB.$
after:
MAGMA got here first. We're not letting them take both ORBS!

And you're not getting through, either!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat
before: You changed course inside my attack…$
after: You got past me, too…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
before: One current broke. Others still run between you and ARCHIE.$
after: ARCHIE's farther up. The others will stop you!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
before: MAGMA guards one lane and calls it order. AQUA attacks from every open current. / Read this one before it carries you away.$
after: We came all this way for the RED ORB. Don't think we're leaving without it!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat
before: You found still water inside the rush…$
after: That wasn't supposed to happen!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
before: You keep interfering, but have you decided what the ORBS should protect?$
after: Why do you keep following us? MAGMA is the one you should be stopping!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
before: We saw you at MT. CHIMNEY. / You reject MAGMA and still pursue AQUA. Then show me the answer you chose.$
after:
You helped stop MAGMA at MT. CHIMNEY. So why are you fighting us now?

Fine! I'll stop you myself!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat
before: You refused both currents…$
after: You're really not on our side…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
before: You adapt too freely for MAGMA and question too much for AQUA. / A lone Trainer should not be able to break two organizations. Prove me wrong.$
after:
You again?! Do you ever get tired of chasing TEAM AQUA?

I'm putting an end to it!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat
before: You needed neither uniform…$
after: Not again!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
before: Our crews make ARCHIE's plans possible. Your team did the same for yours.$
after: ARCHIE will know what to do. He has to.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
before: Oh, my goodness… / You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE have been awakened? / It is said that the BLUE ORB and the RED ORB quelled the rage of the two POKéMON… / It is also said that the true owner of the ORBS still exists. / However, no one knows who, or what exactly, the ORBS belong to. / It could be a human, or perhaps a POKéMON, but no one knows.$
after:
Both GROUDON and KYOGRE are awake? Then we are all in danger.

The ORBS are part of their ancient bond. They are no guarantee of obedience.

Only RAYQUAZA stopped their last clash. You must find someone who knows where it rests.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
before: The two men who took the ORBS came back to return them on their own. / Those men… Perhaps they are not so evil after all…$
after:
The two men returned the ORBS themselves. They finally saw what their plans would do to HOENN.

I am glad they came back. But repairing the harm will take more than returning what they stole.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
before: The old legend named three great powers. SOOTOPOLIS added a fourth: the Trainer who understood why balance mattered. / Will you hear HOENN's new legend?$
after:
Our old tale tells how RAYQUAZA stopped a terrible clash. Now we have seen it happen again.

Will you hear what people are saying about SOOTOPOLIS?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
before: ARCHIE: KYOGRE, the current before maps, borders, or human permission. / The ocean itself answers your call. Today the sea becomes free again!$
after:
ARCHIE: Look at it, {PLAYER}. KYOGRE! The POKéMON that made the sea.

With its power, the ocean can grow. Sea POKéMON will have all the space they need!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
before: You chased us through every changing route and answered every formation. / One final current stands between you and my dream. Survive it if you can.$
after:
You've chased us this far. But I won't let you stop us now!

This dream means everything to TEAM AQUA!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
before: You kept your shape while breaking mine.$
after: No… Not after coming so far!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
before: ARCHIE: Heavy rain? Good. The current is moving exactly as planned. / What? Routes flooded, crews trapped, and the pressure still rising? / No. Freedom was not supposed to erase everything it connected.$
after:
ARCHIE: Heavy rain? Good! KYOGRE is expanding the sea!

What? The routes are flooding? Our own crews are trapped?

Tell them to get to high ground! How can the rain still be getting worse?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
before: ARCHIE: The RED ORB woke KYOGRE, but it never promised me control. / I mistook motion for obedience.$
after:
ARCHIE: The RED ORB woke KYOGRE. Why won't it answer me now?

I never wanted people to get hurt…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
before: MAXIE: ARCHIE, KYOGRE's rain is spreading beyond the coast. GROUDON will answer with its own power. / If they clash, neither the land nor the people you meant to free will survive.$
after:
MAXIE: ARCHIE! KYOGRE's rain is spreading, and GROUDON's heat is getting worse.

If they meet, the people and POKéMON of HOENN will be caught between them!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
before: ARCHIE: Your certainty woke GROUDON! My mistake only mirrors yours. / And the RED ORB should still let me... No. We never understood the ORBS.$
after:
ARCHIE: You're the one who woke GROUDON!

I thought the ORB would let me control KYOGRE. But it's not listening. Neither of them is!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
before: MAXIE: Blame is another wasted turn. Outside, HOENN is breaking now. / Look at the world our perfect answers created.$
after:
MAXIE: We can argue later! We need to get everyone out of this cavern.

Come and see what's happening outside, ARCHIE. We have to stop it.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
before: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you have walked more of HOENN than any of us. / Do you know where RAYQUAZA is now?$
after:
WALLACE: Where might a POKéMON of the sky rest?

Have you heard of any place on your travels that could shelter RAYQUAZA?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
before: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN? / But that's right here! I need you to do better than that! / Please, I need you to think about where RAYQUAZA might be right now.$
after:
WALLACE: We've searched the CAVE OF ORIGIN. There is no sign of RAYQUAZA here.

Perhaps somewhere higher, closer to the sky?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
before: WALLACE: MT. PYRE? / But when I met the old lady there earlier, she made no mention of it. / I very much doubt that the old lady would try to hide something from me… / {PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this more carefully for me?$
after:
WALLACE: The elders at MT. PYRE told me RAYQUAZA's story, but it doesn't rest there.

Perhaps another place high above the sea?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
before: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember? Hmm… That's a problem… / Can't you remember somehow?$
after:
WALLACE: There is an old tower called SKY PILLAR, near ROUTE 131. It reaches high above the sea.

Could that be the place we're looking for?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyIntro
before: COURTNEY: Prediction: you will target the sun before noticing the split pressure. / Let us measure how quickly you correct.$
after:
COURTNEY: You reached the chamber.

MAXIE must not be interrupted. I will stop you here.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyDefeat
before: Correction arrived before failure. Noted.$
after: COURTNEY: Defeated… Again.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyAfter
before: MAXIE values certainty. You keep proving that adaptation is also measurable.$
after:
COURTNEY: MAXIE is just ahead.

GROUDON… What will it do when it wakes?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
before: MAXIE promised solid ground under every home in HOENN. I believe him. / MANDIBUZZ taunts, MAMOSWINE crushes. You will not reach the chamber.$
after:
MAXIE promised solid ground under every home in HOENN. I believe him.

You're not getting into that chamber!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
before: You moved before my TAUNT mattered…$
after: You beat my whole team…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
before: None of us have seen GROUDON. MAXIE keeps it behind the last door. / I wonder if certainty needs a door.$
after:
None of us have seen GROUDON. MAXIE keeps the last chamber closed.

The mountain's shaking. I hope he knows what he's doing.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
before: Sun, sand, and GARCHOMP's stone. MAXIE built this formation for one outcome. / Soon! Very soon our ground will hold!$
after:
Can you feel the mountain shaking? That's GROUDON's power!

MAXIE's waited years for this. I won't let you spoil it!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
before: The formation had one answer, and you found the other…$
after: I couldn't stop you…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
before: AMOONGUSS pulls your attacks. RHYPERIOR turns the ones that land into power. / You're not getting by me easily!$
after:
This is the last chamber. GROUDON is just beyond us.

You want to stop MAXIE? You'll have to get past me!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
before: You hit the slot I left open…$
after: My team couldn't hold you back…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
before: Go on, then. Tell MAXIE the ground moved under us too.$
after: That tremor… Was it stronger than the last one?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
before: TABITHA: Every chamber behind you was built to make one approach predictable. / MAXIE is already with GROUDON. I only need to make your last answer too slow.$
after:
TABITHA: You've made it through the entire hideout. I should have expected it.

MAXIE is with GROUDON. This is the moment we've worked for.

I'm not letting you take it from us!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
before: Your last answer was faster than my model allowed…$
after: Even here, I couldn't defeat you…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
before: Every minute you spent on me was one more MAXIE had with GROUDON. / Go and see what certainty awakened.$
after:
TABITHA: MAXIE is just ahead.

The shaking keeps getting worse. What is happening in there?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
before: MAXIE: GROUDON! The model was exact. Why did the ORB make you reject me? / Where are you going?$
after:
MAXIE: GROUDON! What's wrong? The BLUE ORB was supposed to awaken you!

Wait! Where are you going?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
before: MAXIE: You again. GROUDON fled before you touched the machine. / Then prove the error is mine, not yours.$
after:
MAXIE: You! Did you see that? GROUDON left without a single command.

Don't look at me like that. You won't stop TEAM MAGMA!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
before: MAXIE: Your team adapted; my plan did not. I understand the lesson. / But GROUDON is loose, and ARCHIE still holds the matching disaster. / He needs STERN's submarine to reach the seafloor. STERN is in SLATEPORT. / Go to the harbor in northeast SLATEPORT and warn CAPT. STERN. / I will follow GROUDON. This is no longer an experiment we control.$
after:
MAXIE: GROUDON is loose. I have to find out why the ORB failed to control it.

ARCHIE still has the RED ORB. He'll need STERN's submarine to reach KYOGRE on the seafloor.

Go warn CAPT. STERN at the harbor in northeast SLATEPORT.

I'm going after GROUDON.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
before: The INSTITUTE mapped every pressure shift before the storm arrived. / ARCHIE needs those maps. You are not interrupting this current again.$
after:
These maps show storms all over HOENN. ARCHIE wants to know where they begin.

He'll get his answers. You're not getting upstairs!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
before: You read the pressure change first…$
after: I couldn't keep you out…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
before: You crossed the flooded grass alone? Then this indoor front will not stop you. / I will change the forecast myself.$
after:
You crossed all that rain to get here? Should've stayed where it was dry!

Now you've got TEAM AQUA to deal with!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
before: My forecast failed completely…$
after: So much for scaring you off…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
before: The bed restores exhausted teams. Use it. SHELLY is upstairs with the researchers. That is your next front.$
after:
There's a bed over there. You might want to rest.

SHELLY's upstairs with the researchers. She's tougher than I am.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
before: CASTFORM reads a battlefield before the first drop falls. AQUA needs that gift. / You will not reach the research wing.$
after:
The researchers say CASTFORM changes with the weather. ARCHIE wants to know why!

You can't go into the research wing!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
before: You changed the forecast around me…$
after: I couldn't stop you…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
before: Rare data, rare POKéMON, hidden currents. AQUA follows what the world conceals.$
after:
Weather records, rare POKéMON… This place has everything ARCHIE asked for!

You're not taking it away from us!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
before: You exposed every hidden line…$
after: But I was guarding the records…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
before: ARCHIE wants a world no border can hold. You keep asking what that freedom costs.$
after: We've watched strange storms gather out at sea. ARCHIE says these records will tell us what they mean.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
before: You came for the weather POKéMON, too? / Then you know a changing form can answer more fields than a rigid one. Show me.$
after:
What are you after? The records? The weather POKéMON?

Whatever it is, TEAM AQUA got here first!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
before: Your answer changed one turn sooner…$
after: I couldn't hold my post…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
before: CASTFORM was never the whole objective. The storm records point toward MT. PYRE and its ORBS.$
after: The storm records led us to old stories about MT. PYRE. ARCHIE thinks its ORBS are the key.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
before: SHELLY: We came for weather records. They show what happens when the ancient sea begins to stir. / AQUA changes the battlefield before the opponent can adjust. / Let's see how quickly you read a storm!$
after:
SHELLY: We came for weather records. They show something powerful stirring in the ocean.

You should have stayed out of this, {PLAYER}. I'm not letting you interfere with ARCHIE's work!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyDefeat
before: You found the calm inside my storm…$
after: You've beaten us here, too…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyPostBattle
before: You adapted inside the storm. No wonder ARCHIE remembers you. / The records point to MT. PYRE. We move.$
after:
SHELLY: You're as persistent as ARCHIE said.

We have what we need. These records point to MT. PYRE.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
before: What?! MAGMA already moved toward the BLUE ORB? / The records confirm MT. PYRE is the next node. AQUA, change course now!$
after:
What?! MAGMA is heading for the BLUE ORB?

SHELLY: Then we can't waste another moment here. AQUA! To MT. PYRE!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ThanksPleaseTakePokemon
before: You saved our staff and our data. Take this CASTFORM as a research partner. / It reads weather directly, and old desert records say the land itself knows it.$
after:
You saved us, and our research. Thank you!

This CASTFORM has helped us study the weather. I think it would enjoy traveling with you. Please take it!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
before: You're {PLAYER}, right? I'm MAY. Welcome to LITTLEROOT! / Dad said a GYM LEADER's kid was moving next door. I hoped we'd battle. / He studies how Trainers from different regions build around their partners. / For today's fieldwork, he packed all nine regional starter trios. / He went to ROUTE 101, north of town. Go introduce yourself before he leaves!$
after:
You're {PLAYER}, right? I'm MAY. Welcome to LITTLEROOT!

Dad said a GYM LEADER's family was moving next door. I hoped we'd get to be friends!

He studies POKéMON from all nine regions. He took their starter partners out for fieldwork today.

You can meet him on ROUTE 101, north of town!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
before: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's been too long! / Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's been feeling frisky! / So I've decided to help DOCK make a ferry. / Aye, after all, a ferry would be able to carry a lot of people. / But, you know, that DOCK is really something special. / With his knack for technology and my experience, I'm sure that we can build one great ship, aye!$
after:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's been too long!

I've joined DOCK here at the shipyard. That lad's S.S. TIDAL is a fine vessel!

He knows the engineering, and I know the sea. Together, we'll keep her sailing for years!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
before: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to lend us his help. / Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together.$
after:
DOCK: MR. BRINEY's joined us!

The ferry is sailing, but there's always work to do. His experience at sea is a great help.

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainRazorClaw
before: A Razor Claw evolves Sneasel. Use it at night when ready.$
after:
Use a RAZOR CLAW on SNEASEL at night to evolve it into WEAVILE.

A Hisuian SNEASEL needs it during the day instead, to become SNEASLER.

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
before: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't battle, it can still use a move learned from a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$
after:
Once you have an HM and its BADGE, a compatible partner lets you use that field skill.

It doesn't take up a battle move slot. You can even clear the way if that partner has fainted.

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
before: POKéMON grow from battles, but you never need to grind. / A POKéMON CENTER LEVELER trains your whole party to the current limit.$
after:
POKéMON grow stronger as they gain levels.

The CENTER's free LEVELER brings your whole party to the current limit. It's handy when a new partner joins!

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
before: Raw levels alone won't take you far. / Build different partners for different battles, then change plans when needed.$
after:
Get to know what each partner does well.

A new move or a different teammate can make all the difference in a tough battle.
